name: Opening of the Key
version: Golden Dawn Manuscript Q baseline with separately labeled modern teaching notes

overview.summary: The Opening of the Key is a five-operation Tarot divination. The same question is successively examined through the fourfold YHVH structure, the Twelve Houses, the Twelve Zodiac Signs, the Thirty-Six Decanates, and finally the Ten Sephiroth.
sequence: Operation I — Opening of the Question: Four YHVH packets
Operation II — Development: Twelve Astrological Houses
Operation III — Continuing Development: Twelve Zodiac Signs
Operation IV — Further Development: Thirty-Six Decanates
core_method: Form one question and retain it throughout all five operations.
Traditionally select one of the sixteen Court cards as the Significator.
Preserve the relative order of cards after dealing.
Locate the Significator in the relevant packet or arrangement.
Notice the symbolic field in which the Significator falls.
For horseshoe packets, count from the Significator in the direction its figure faces.
Stop the counting sequence when a card already read is reached.
After counting, pair cards from opposite ends inward.
Use surrounding elemental relationships to qualify the force of a card.
Synthesize the five operations as stages of one question rather than five unrelated readings.
overview.court_note: The historical procedure selects the Significator from the sixteen Court cards. This milestone teaches that procedure, but the application currently models only the 22 Majors and 40 numbered Minors. A future courts.json module can complete the 78-card virtual model.
overview.reversal_note: In Manuscript Q an inverted card is left physically inverted because its facing direction matters, but inversion does not create a separate reversed card meaning.

counting.introduction: The card from which counting begins is itself number 1. Continue counting in the established direction. When the sequence lands on a card already read, the counting sequence ends.

rules.label: Major — Double letter
rules.reason: Seven planetary letters plus Caput and Cauda Draconis in the historical counting explanation

houses.name: First House
houses.teaching: Self, embodiment, immediate circumstances and manner of entering the situation.

houses.name: Second House
houses.teaching: Resources, possessions, material support and what is valued.

houses.name: Third House
houses.teaching: Communication, nearby environment, learning, siblings and short journeys.

houses.name: Fourth House
houses.teaching: Home, foundations, ancestry and private roots.

houses.name: Fifth House
houses.teaching: Pleasure, creativity, play, children and personal expression.

houses.name: Sixth House
houses.teaching: Work, service, routine, maintenance and health-related circumstances.

houses.name: Seventh House
houses.teaching: Partnerships, agreements, marriage and open opposition.

houses.name: Eighth House
houses.teaching: Shared resources, inheritance, loss, transformation and obligations to others.

houses.name: Ninth House
houses.teaching: Religion, philosophy, higher learning, law and long journeys.

houses.name: Tenth House
houses.teaching: Public role, vocation, reputation, authority and visible achievement.

houses.name: Eleventh House
houses.teaching: Friends, groups, alliances, hopes and collective aspirations.

houses.name: Twelfth House
houses.teaching: Withdrawal, confinement, hidden matters, isolation and what operates outside ordinary awareness.

operations.title: Opening of the Question
operations.purpose: Shows the matter as it presently stands and identifies the elemental/YHVH field in which the Significator appears.
steps: Choose the Significator before beginning. In the historical procedure this is one of the sixteen Court cards.
Form the question clearly and keep the same question throughout the complete Opening of the Key.
The enquirer shuffles the complete deck while concentrating on the matter.
Place the deck face down as a single packet.
Cut approximately in half and move the upper portion to the right.
Cut the right-hand packet approximately in half and move its upper portion farther right.
Cut the left-hand packet approximately in half, placing its upper portion to the left.
You now have four packets. From right to left they correspond to Yod, Heh, Vau and Heh-final.
Turn all four packets face up without changing their relative order.
Read the four exposed cards as a preliminary indication. Their elemental dignity relative to the packet position can strengthen or weaken their expression.
Examine the packets without changing card order and locate the Significator.
Record whether the Significator falls under Yod/Fire, Heh/Water, Vau/Air or Heh-final/Earth.
Retain only the packet containing the Significator for the detailed reading.
Spread that packet face up into a horseshoe while preserving its order.
Notice the predominant suit, concentrations of repeated ranks, and any unusual predominance of Major Arcana.
Begin counting from the Significator. The Significator itself counts as number 1.
Count in the direction the Significator faces.
At each selected card, use that card's own counting value to determine the next selected card.
Continue until the count lands on a card already selected.
Interpret the resulting chain as a narrative.
Then pair the cards from opposite ends of the horseshoe inward. Do not skip the Significator if it becomes part of a pair.
Combine the packet's elemental field, the counting narrative, the pairs and elemental dignities into the Operation I interpretation.

operations.title: Development of the Matter
operations.purpose: Places the developing matter within one of the twelve fields of experience represented by the Astrological Houses.
steps: Gather the complete deck again.
The enquirer shuffles while continuing to concentrate on the original question.
Do not cut the deck in this operation.
Deal one card at a time face down into twelve packets in rotation.
Packet 1 corresponds to House I, packet 2 to House II, continuing through House XII.
Continue dealing cyclically until the complete deck has been distributed.
Preserve both the order of the packets and the relative order of cards within each packet.
Locate the Significator without disturbing the cards.
Record which Astrological House contains the Significator.
Use that House as the broad field in which the matter is presently developing.
Set the other eleven packets aside.
Spread the retained packet face up into a horseshoe.
Notice suit predominance, repeated ranks and concentrations of Major Arcana.
Count from the Significator in the direction its figure faces.
Stop when the sequence lands on a card already read.
Interpret the counting sequence as a narrative.
Pair opposite ends of the horseshoe inward.
Interpret the pairs and surrounding elemental dignities.
Relate the result back to the House containing the Significator and to Operation I.

operations.title: Continuing Development
operations.purpose: Examines the developing question through the twelve Zodiacal modes and their corresponding Major Arcana.
steps: Gather the complete deck.
Shuffle again while retaining the same original question.
Do not cut.
Deal the deck into twelve packets in exactly the same cyclic manner used in Operation II.
Assign the packets in Zodiacal order from Aries through Pisces.
Locate the Significator without altering card order.
Record the Zodiac sign containing the Significator.
Also note the Golden Dawn Major Arcana associated with that Zodiac sign.
Set the other eleven packets aside.
Spread the selected packet as a horseshoe.
Notice suit predominance, repeated ranks and Major Arcana concentration.
Count from the Significator in the direction its figure faces.
Continue until a previously selected card is reached.
Interpret the counting sequence.
Pair opposite ends inward.
Interpret the pairs and elemental dignities.
Relate the Zodiacal quality and its Major Arcana to the results of Operations I and II.

operations.title: Further Development
operations.purpose: Examines the further development of the matter through the thirty-six ten-degree Zodiacal divisions represented by the numbered Minor Arcana from Two through Ten.
steps: Gather and shuffle the complete deck while holding the original question in mind.
Do not make an ordinary random cut.
Turn the deck face up and carefully search through it without changing the relative order until the Significator is found.
Cut at the Significator so that the Significator becomes the first card for the new arrangement while all relative order is otherwise preserved.
Turn the deck face down again.
Remove the Significator and place it face up in the center.
Deal the next thirty-six cards face up in a circle around the Significator.
These thirty-six positions correspond symbolically to the thirty-six Decanates.
Notice the predominant suit, repeated ranks and concentration of Major Arcana among the thirty-six cards.
Unlike the horseshoe operations, begin counting from the first of the thirty-six dealt cards rather than from the Significator.
Always count in the same direction in which the thirty-six cards were dealt.
Apply the normal counting value of each selected card.
Stop when the sequence returns to a card already selected.
Interpret this counting chain.
Pair card 1 with card 36, card 2 with card 35, card 3 with card 34, continuing inward.
Interpret each pair with attention to elemental dignity and the surrounding cards.
Relate the decanic development back to Operations I through III.

operations.title: Conclusion of the Matter
operations.purpose: Places the termination or conclusion of the question within one of the ten Sephiroth of the Tree of Life.
steps: Gather the complete deck again.
Shuffle while retaining the same question.
Do not cut.
Deal one card at a time into ten packets in rotation.
Packet 1 corresponds to Kether, packet 2 to Chokmah, continuing through packet 10, Malkuth.
Continue cyclically until the whole deck is distributed.
Locate the Significator without changing card order.
Record the Sephirah containing the Significator.
Treat that Sephirah as the broad Qabalistic context of the conclusion rather than as a simple positive or negative verdict.
Set the other nine packets aside.
Spread the selected packet into a horseshoe.
Notice suit predominance, repeated ranks and concentrations of Major Arcana.
Count from the Significator in the direction its figure faces.
Stop when a previously selected card is reached.
Interpret the counting chain.
Pair cards from opposite ends inward.
Interpret elemental dignity and the relationship of each pair.
Synthesize the Sephirah, the counting narrative and the pairings.
Finally synthesize all five operations: opening condition, House development, Zodiacal development, decanic development and Sephirothic conclusion.
